renderings.value: She shouted and threatened a policeman by brandishing a knife.
She smoothly and elegantly poured the water into the glass.
The way she flips her ponytail will charm you before you realise it.
She was on the point of laughing at the clown's actions.
Her movements were awkward and her gesture clumsy.
Since he's in show business he often goofs around in a showy way, but once in a while he has these bashful mannerisms that are really cute.
He responded by giving the "OK" gesture.
The gesture fetched a laugh from the audience.
Just as one gesture can have many different meanings, many different gestures can have the same meaning.

Just as water, gas, and electricity are brought into our houses from far off to satisfy our needs in response to a minimal effort, so we shall be supplied with visual or auditory images, which will appear and disappear at a simple movement of the hand, hardly more than a sign.
"I wonder, is Tom really a boy?" "What do you mean?" "Well, I mean, he's just so cute, plus he behaves like a girl..."
You, your voice, your face, your gestures...none of it comes to mind.
